The project's migration rule says every merged migration has already run in production, so edits to existing files never reach it. New changes need the next 4-digit number. The last file is `0007`, so yours is `0008`.

Suggested contents:

```sql
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN phone TEXT;
```

I made it nullable because existing rows have no phone number. A `NOT NULL` column would need a default or a backfill.

`0007` also has a typo: the column is `emial`, not `email`. Don't fix it in place. If you want to correct it, do that in a separate `ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;` migration. That would also break any code that reads `emial`, so check for that first.
